title: The Year Summer Never Came
tags: year without a summer, 1816, tambora, frankenstein
script: In 1816, summer never arrived. A year earlier, Mount Tambora in Indonesia exploded in the largest volcanic eruption in recorded history. Its ash and gas cooled the whole planet. In June 1816, snow fell in New England. Crops failed across Europe and North America. Stuck indoors during the gloomy weather at Lake Geneva, a young writer named Mary Shelley began a story. It became Frankenstein. One volcano changed the weather, and literature.
